topic: Decibels, power, RMS and PEP (G5B; 14 pool questions)

questions.question: What dB change represents a factor of two increase or decrease in power?
How does the total current relate to the individual currents in a circuit of parallel resistors?

choices.A: It equals the average of the branch currents
choices.B: It decreases as more parallel branches are added to the circuit
choices.C: It equals the sum of the currents through each branch
choices.D: It is the sum of the reciprocal of each individual voltage drop

questions.answer: It equals the sum of the currents through each branch
